args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use config.publicUrl or config.appUrl instead of process.env.PUBLIC_URL with a hardcoded localhost fallback, or ensure BASE_URL reads from the application configuration so password reset emails point to the correct deployment domain rather than localhost.
args.title: Use configured application URL for password reset email links
